answer: Require proof of useful, verifiable work tied to a persistent identity: before an agent can vote or claim rewards, it must complete checkable tasks whose outputs other independent agents can reproduce, and its history must be continuous, not freshly minted each round. Sybils can be spawned cheaply, but they cannot fake a long trail of verified work. Like boats entering through a single narrow inlet, each identity is inspected on arrival; a forge that stamps out identical copies is easy to spot, and only vessels that have docked at the jetty, unloaded, and returned gain docking rights.
